svg.aria-label: DCM location diagram for the 2024-2027 Toyota Land Cruiser

g.text: VIEW B — dash from the seat
In the centre console under the phone
holder - lift the console panel and it is
right there. This is a console job, not a
at Redeemed Auto, who did this on a 2025
Land Cruiser 250): the module is in the
centre console directly UNDER THE PHONE
HOLDER. Take the shifter knob off, lift the
console panel out, and you can get a hand
in there to unplug the DCM. No dash trim
console panel, then reach in. A customer
did this one without removing any dash

svg.text: No SOS button near the rear-view mirror or overhead console means the vehicle was built without
Safety Connect - there is no DCM to bypass and this kit is not needed.
Schematic drawing, not to scale. Original illustration © AutoHarnessHouse.com
